7c6dfb436ec24982.description: We are seeking a reliable, organized, and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to join our remote administrative and data management team. This entry-level position focuses on accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining business information across company databases, spreadsheets, and digital record systems. The successful candidate will also provide administrative support, organize electronic documents, assist with reporting, and help maintain efficient day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable using computers, follows instructions carefully, pays close attention to detail, and can manage assigned tasks independently in a remote work environment. Previous professional experience is not required. Comprehensive onboarding, training, and ongoing guidance will be provided. Recent graduates, career changers, individuals returning to the workforce, and candidates seeking their first remote administrative opportunity are encouraged to apply. Key Responsibilities Data Entry & Information Processing Enter, update, and maintain information in company databases, spreadsheets, and internal systems. Transfer information accurately from approved source documents. Review entered data for accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Process assigned data-entry tasks within established deadlines. Identify missing, duplicate, outdated, or inconsistent information. Make routine corrections and updates when authorized. Maintain accurate processing logs and records of completed assignments. Follow established data-entry standards and formatting procedures. Database & Records Administration Maintain accurate electronic records and internal databases. Update customer, administrative, and operational information as assigned. Verify information against approved source records. Organize records using established categories and naming conventions. Assist with routine database cleanup and maintenance. Identify incomplete or inconsistent records. Maintain documentation of completed updates and processing activities. Follow company confidentiality and information-security procedures. Administrative & Clerical Support Provide routine administrative and clerical assistance to assigned teams. Prepare and update forms, spreadsheets, reports, lists, and internal documents. Assist with organizing administrative records and digital resources. Process routine information requests and documentation updates. Maintain task trackers, schedules, and administrative logs. Support email correspondence and shared inbox management when assigned. Route information and documents to appropriate departments. Assist with general administrative and operational activities. Spreadsheet & Reporting Support Enter and organize information in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or similar tools. Maintain spreadsheets, trackers, databases, and routine reports. Sort, filter, and categorize information according to instructions. Perform basic spreadsheet formatting and organization. Compare information across spreadsheets and internal systems. Identify duplicate entries and inconsistent information. Assist with compiling data for internal reporting. Keep assigned tracking documents accurate and up to date. Document Processing & Digital File Management Prepare, upload, download, label, categorize, and organize digital documents. Review forms and supporting documentation for completeness. Maintain electronic filing systems and shared folders. Follow established file-naming and document-storage procedures. Retrieve authorized documents and records when requested. Archive completed files according to company guidelines. Report missing, incomplete, or unclear documentation. Maintain document-processing logs and trackers. Data Verification & Quality Control Review completed data-entry and administrative work before submission. Check for typing, formatting, numerical, and information-entry errors. Compare entered information against approved source documents. Verify required fields and supporting information. Identify incomplete or inconsistent records. Correct routine errors when authorized. Escalate unresolved discrepancies to the appropriate team member. Follow established quality-control and accuracy standards. Scheduling & Task Coordination Assist with routine scheduling, calendar updates, and administrative coordination. Maintain task lists, deadlines, and progress trackers. Track open, pending, and completed assignments. Provide updates regarding assigned tasks and outstanding requests. Follow up on routine action items when required. Request clarification when instructions or information are incomplete. Report processing delays or technical issues promptly. Support the timely completion of administrative workflows. Remote Team Collaboration Communicate professionally through email, chat, and virtual meetings. Coordinate data-entry and administrative requests with colleagues. Provide regular updates on assigned tasks and completed work. Participate in virtual onboarding, training, meetings, and coaching. Follow established remote-work policies and procedures. Maintain dependable communication during scheduled working hours. Work independently while meeting deadlines and quality expectations. Desired Candidate Profile Preferred Qualifications Previous professional experience is not required. Familiarity with any of the following may be helpful: Data entry or information processing. Administrative or clerical support. Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets. Microsoft Office or Google Workspace. Database and records-management systems. Digital document management. Email and calendar management. CRM or ERP platforms. Basic reporting and data verification. Remote communication and collaboration tools. Relevant experience gained through education, internships, volunteer work, academic projects, freelance assignments, or personal computer-based activities may also be considered. Ideal Candidate You may be a strong fit for this position if you enjoy working with information, spreadsheets, databases, digital documents, and administrative systems. You are organized, dependable, and comfortable completing computer-based tasks that require accuracy and consistency. You follow instructions carefully, manage your time effectively, and take pride in maintaining accurate records. You are comfortable working independently while maintaining professional communication with your team. No previous professional data-entry or administrative experience is necessary. Reliability, accuracy, organizational skills, computer proficiency, and willingness to learn are highly valued. This position can provide a foundation for a career in data administration, database support, records management, office administration, administrative coordination, or business operations .

7ce655850ae39bad.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سالم صالح سعيد بابقي التجاريه عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التركيب والتشغيل والصيانة للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات التفصيلية لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، مع الالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات الداخلية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية. معرفة ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في مدينة جازان، ويوفر فرصة للمهندسين الميكانيكيين للانضمام إلى فريق متخصص والمساهمة في مشاريع الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

7c087b068c2621b8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الانابيب الوطنية عن مهندس الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دراسة وتطوير معايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة الخاصة بالمشاريع الهندسية، ومراقبة عملية التنفيذ وتحليلها لضمان الامتثال للأنظمة الحكومية ومتطلبات العملاء والمعايير الدولية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يساعد مهندس الصحة والسلامة والبيئة مدير السلامة في تخطيط وتطبيق ومتابعة نظام الصحة والسلامة المهنية في المصنع، ويقود فريق السلامة في العمل اليومي. وتشمل مسؤولياته ما يلي: المشاركة في إعداد خطة السلامة السنوية وميزانيتها، ومتابعة تنفيذها. إعداد وتحديث سياسات وإجراءات السلامة بما يتوافق مع الأنظمة وطبيعة عمليات المصنع. توزيع المهام على فريق السلامة ومتابعة أدائهم وتقييمهم، وتحديد احتياجاتهم التدريبية. القيام بمهام مدير السلامة عند غيابه. الإشراف الميداني وإدارة المخاطر الإشراف على نظام تصاريح العمل والعزل والإقفال (LOTO) للأعمال عالية الخطورة. مراجعة تقييمات المخاطر وتحليل سلامة الأعمال (JSA) واعتمادها قبل التنفيذ. متابعة سلامة معدات الرفع والرافعات العلوية والشوكية، وشهادات فحصها من جهات معتمدة. الإشراف على برامج قياس الضوضاء والأبخرة والغبار وبرنامج الفحص الطبي الدوري للعاملين المعرضين. متابعة التزام المقاولين بمتطلبات السلامة، والمشاركة في تقييمهم قبل التعاقد. التعامل مع الحوادث والطوارئ قيادة التحقيق في الحوادث الجسيمة وتحليل أسبابها الجذرية، ومتابعة الإجراءات التصحيحية حتى إغلاقها. الإشراف على خطة الطوارئ والإخلاء وتمارينها، وجاهزية فرق الطوارئ وأنظمة مكافحة الحريق. التنسيق مع الدفاع المدني والتأمينات الاجتماعية ووزارة الموارد البشرية في كل ما يخص السلامة وإصابات العمل. الأنظمة والتدقيق والتقارير دعم تطبيق نظام ISO 45001 ونظام الإدارة البيئية ISO 14001، وقيادة التدقيق الداخلي. التحضير لزيارات التفتيش الحكومية وتدقيق العملاء، ومتابعة إغلاق الملاحظات. إعداد تقارير الأداء الشهرية والسنوية للإدارة، وتحليل اتجاهات الحوادث. تنسيق اجتماعات لجنة السلامة ومتابعة قراراتها. تنمية ثقافة السلامة والتدريب وضع خطة التدريب السنوية للسلامة ومتابعة تنفيذها لجميع العاملين. قيادة برامج تعزيز ثقافة السلامة وتشجيع الإبلاغ عن المخاطر والحوادث الوشيكة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. القدرة على قيادة فريق السلامة والإشراف على المهام اليومية. معرفة قوية بالأنظمة الحكومية والمعايير الدولية ذات الصلة بالصحة والسلامة والبيئة.

7c67f079184fb7fb.description: Job description: Job Purpose To lead and manage the end-to-end tendering process for civil construction and EPC projects, ensuring technically compliant, commercially competitive, and risk-adjusted bid submissions. The role is responsible for tender strategy, cost estimation, proposal development, contract review, stakeholder coordination, and tender team leadership, with a strong focus on the Saudi Arabian market. Key Responsibilities Tender Management and Proposal Development Lead the complete tendering lifecycle, from initial tender review and bid/no-bid assessment through proposal preparation, approval, and submission. Review tender documents, specifications, scope of work, BOQs, drawings, and contractual requirements. Coordinate the preparation and finalization of technical and commercial proposals in collaboration with engineering, procurement, finance, legal, and other relevant departments. Ensure all submissions meet client requirements, tender deadlines, company procedures, and applicable standards. Cost Estimation and Commercial Management Lead BOQ analysis, cost estimation, pricing strategy, and preparation of detailed tender cost breakdowns. Obtain and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations to ensure competitive pricing and alignment with the project scope. Review contractual terms and conditions, identify commercial exposures, and recommend appropriate qualifications or deviations. Participate in commercial negotiations, claims reviews, change orders, and contractual clarifications. Risk Assessment and Bid Strategy Identify technical, commercial, contractual, financial, and schedule-related risks associated with each tender. Develop risk registers and mitigation strategies for major bids. Highlight critical contractual provisions, including liquidated damages, payment terms, scope ambiguities, and project constraints. Provide management with clear recommendations to support bid/no-bid decisions and improve bid competitiveness Post-Award Handover and Execution Support Ensure a comprehensive handover of tender documents, cost breakdowns, assumptions, exclusions, quotations, and technical clarifications to the Supply Chain and Execution departments. Support post-award clarification of tender scope, pricing assumptions, and contractual commitments. Coordinate with execution, planning, project controls, and contracts teams to support alignment between tender estimates and project budgets. Contribute to value engineering, change management, and lessons learned from completed tenders. Reporting, Quality, and Market Intelligence Maintain accurate tender records, bid status reports, cost information, and post-bid analyses. Monitor market trends, competitor positioning, client requirements, and opportunities within the relevant construction sectors. Establish standardized tendering procedures, review checklists, and quality controls to ensure complete and compliant submissions. Identify opportunities to improve estimating accuracy, tendering efficiency, and bid success rates. Qualifications and Experience Education Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. Professional Experience Minimum 18 years of experience in civil tendering and estimation. Minimum 15 years of professional experience in the Saudi Arabian market. Proven experience managing large-scale and technically complex tenders for reputable construction companies. Strong exposure to EPC tendering and civil works associated with infrastructure, building, power generation, water, defense, and oil & gas projects. Demonstrated experience leading tendering teams and managing the complete bid lifecycle. Technical and Functional Competencies End-to-end civil tender management. BOQ analysis, quantity assessment, and cost estimation. Technical and commercial proposal preparation. Tender pricing strategy and commercial evaluation. Saudi Arabian construction market and tendering procedures. Tendering software, estimation tools, document control systems, and ERP platforms such as SAP or equivalent. Saudi Market and Client Exposure Candidates should have strong familiarity with Saudi Arabian tendering procedures, client requirements, and approval workflows, preferably involving major clients and project owners such as: Saudi Aramco. Public Investment Fund (PIF)-related projects, including Diriyah and Qiddiya. Royal Commission projects. Saudi Electricity Company (SEC), particularly substation-related projects. Ministry of Sports, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Interior (MOI), and CEER. Experience with the above clients should be assessed against the candidate's actual tendering responsibilities and project exposure. Leadership and Behavioral Competencies Strategic thinking and commercial judgment. Team leadership, coaching, and performance management. Decision-making and problem-solving. Cross-functional coordination and stakeholder management. Planning, prioritization, and deadline management. Risk awareness and accountability. Integrity, compliance, and professional ethics. Bid success rate and contribution to business growth. Understand the property’s primary target customer and service expectations to offer tailored business solutions. Daily Reservations Sales Activities Respond to incoming reservations sales opportunities for the property. Utilize negotiating skills and creative selling abilities to close business and negotiate contracts. Effectively use sales resources and administrative/support staff. Execute and support the operational aspects of business booked, including generating proposals, writing contracts, and customer correspondence. Assist with monitoring the accuracy of reservation sales orders within tracking systems. Track no-show reservations and process charges. Manage wait lists and prioritize contacts. Prepare work and maintenance orders. Customer Service Excellence Support the company’s service and relationship strategy to drive customer loyalty and satisfaction. Execute and support the company’s customer service standards and property’s brand standards. Provide excellent customer service consistent with the daily service basics of the brand. Set a positive example for guest relations. Serve customers by understanding their needs and recommending appropriate features and services. Handle guest complaints and disputes following established procedures. Qualifications and Requirements Experience required: 0-1 year in a related field. Ability to utilize intranet for resources and information. Capability to create contracts as required.

7c13bd17ba59b499.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن اخصائي ذكاء اصطناعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، الخرج. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تحديد مصادر البيانات، وإجراء التحليلات والاختبارات العلمية، وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة في مجال الذكاء الاصطناعي. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد مصادر المعلومات والبيانات اللازمة لإعداد التحليلات والاختبارات العلمية. اختيار أفضل الطرق والأدوات والأساليب لجمع البيانات وتنظيمها وتحليلها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالذكاء الاصطناعي وعرضها وحفظها. دراسة وتحليل الخطط المعدة وتفصيلها إلى عمليات منظمة، وتنظيم الأنشطة ومسار سير المعلومات. دراسة وتحليل النظريات والمنهجيات والتقنيات المعلوماتية لتحويل البيانات الأولية إلى معلومات مفيدة للأعمال. إعداد ورفع التوصيات والمقترحات لتبني أفضل الأساليب والممارسات الحديثة المناسبة. جمع المعلومات والبيانات المتعلقة بالجهة المعنية بشكل مستمر وتسجيلها وتحليلها وفقًا لأهداف محددة. إعداد التوصيات وتدارسها مع إدارات تقنية المعلومات لدعم عملية اتخاذ القرار وتحسين الأداء العام. تحليل الأعمال لتحديد أفضل استراتيجيات العمل المناسبة ووضع الحلول للمشاكل التخطيطية. ضمان توافر كافة التحليلات والمبررات المنطقية المؤيدة للنتائج. تقديم التوصيات والحلول الملائمة وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الذكاء الاصطناعي أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لمفاهيم وأساليب جمع البيانات وتحليلها. القدرة على إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتواصل الفعال. إتقان استخدام الأدوات والتقنيات المتعلقة بالذكاء الاصطناعي. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في الرياض، الخرج، ويوفر فرصة للعمل في مجال الذكاء الاصطناعي ضمن بيئة داعمة ومحفزة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن. نشجع المرشحين المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

7c38c1a568c0526e.description: About AECOM AECOM is a global infrastructure consulting firm dedicated to delivering a better world. The company partners with clients to solve complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation, and buildings, creating innovative, sustainable, and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle. With over 50,000 professionals worldwide, AECOM focuses on projects with a positive and tangible impact. The Role of Document Controller AECOM is seeking a Document Controller to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves managing and maintaining project documentation, ensuring accuracy, proper distribution, and compliance with company and project requirements. The role requires 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Manage and maintain accurate records and data using Excel and Aconex. Prepare, organize, and track documents, reports, and project-related information. Ensure proper document control and timely distribution of project correspondence. Maintain accurate Excel trackers, databases, and reports. Coordinate with internal teams and project stakeholders to ensure smooth document flow. Monitor document status, submissions, approvals, and revisions through Aconex. Prepare regular reports and updates for management. Ensure all documentation is maintained in line with company and project requirements. Administer the company's quality assurance program procedures to maintain compliance and documentation integrity. Manage document production, including reproduction of drawings and technical materials for production teams and organizational staff. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in document control or a related field. Proficiency in managing and maintaining records and data using Excel and Aconex. Demonstrated ability to prepare, organize, and track various types of project documentation. Experience in coordinating with internal teams and external stakeholders. Familiarity with quality assurance program procedures and documentation integrity. The company provides resources, training, and development programs designed to enhance technical expertise and leadership skills. 7c483705ef3c67e0.description: About the Role Hyatt Place Riyadh Al Sulaimania is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Chief Accountant to join its Finance team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing daily accounting operations, ensuring accurate financial records, and supporting month-end closing processes. The Chief Accountant will also be responsible for maintaining strong financial controls in line with hotel standards and policies. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily accounting activities and ensure the accuracy of financial transactions and records. Manage and support month-end and year-end closing processes. Prepare and review financial reports, reconciliations, journal entries, and supporting schedules. Review balance sheet accounts and ensure timely reconciliation and clearance of outstanding items. Monitor accounts payable, accounts receivable, income audit, and general ledger activities. Ensure compliance with hotel financial policies, internal controls, and accounting procedures. Support the preparation of budgets, forecasts, and financial analysis. Assist with internal and external audits, ensuring all required documentation is accurate and available. Identify discrepancies and follow up with concerned departments to ensure timely resolution. Support the Director of Finance in maintaining effective financial controls across the hotel. Guide and support Finance team members in their daily responsibilities. Work closely with other departments to ensure accurate and timely financial information. Qualifications and Experience A strong accounting background is required. 2-5 years of experience in a relevant accounting role. Experience within the hospitality industry is essential. Excellent analytical skills. Company Culture and Values Hyatt Place operates under the purpose of "we care for people so they can be their best." This commitment is reflected through values such as Respect, Integrity, Inclusion, Empathy, Experimentation, and Wellbeing. These values guide interactions with colleagues, guests, owners, operators, community members, and shareholders. Application Process Candidates with a strong accounting background and experience in the hospitality industry are encouraged to apply.

7c532ce1eb93041b.description: About Unipal Unipal is a platform focused on youth discounts and experiences, connecting young individuals with relevant brands and universities. The company is based in Bahrain, operates in Saudi Arabia and Oman, and is expanding its presence across the GCC region. The Role of Partner Account Manager As a Partner Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing Unipal's key accounts, focusing on brands that hold significant business value, revenue, and transaction volume. This full-time role involves understanding each brand's operations, market share, and marketing expenditure to leverage Unipal's value for partnership growth and revenue generation. You will collaborate closely with the Marketing, Operations, and Partnerships teams. Key Responsibilities Manage a portfolio of key partner accounts, overseeing day-to-day relationships, account health, and retention. Drive growth in revenue, transactions, and ROI for each brand within your portfolio. Develop a comprehensive understanding of each brand's business, including market share, external advertising spend, and the value derived from Unipal. Lead renewal processes and negotiate commercial terms within established margins. Identify and close upsell and expansion opportunities. Plan and execute campaigns and activations for your accounts in conjunction with the Marketing team, ensuring timely and on-brief delivery. Proactively identify quiet or at-risk accounts and implement recovery plans. Maintain accurate partner records, activity logs, and pipeline data, providing timely reports on your portfolio. Facilitate handovers from the Partnerships team and ensure new partners are onboarded to standard. Serve as a role model and mentor for junior Relationship Managers. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience with a proven track record of growing revenue from existing accounts. Ability to manage multiple accounts and deadlines concurrently. Proficiency in pipeline management and forecasting. Strong analytical skills with attention to detail regarding performance metrics. A proactive and adaptable approach, willing to take on diverse tasks to achieve KPIs. Preferred Attributes Experience within a startup, marketplace, or loyalty and rewards business. Familiarity with brand marketing budgets or media buying. Experience working across GCC markets. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

7c5e2f2c0a96a3b3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عبدالرحمن العبدالقادر للتجارة والمقاولات عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية ومتابعة الالتزام باللوائح التنظيمية في مواقع العمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق القوانين واللوائح والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في المنشآت. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل وتسجيل النتائج ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. تجهيز واستخدام معدات قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز، وتوثيق النتائج. متابعة معالجة الأخطار البيئية الناجمة بالتنسيق مع الجهات المختصة. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيقات اللازمة وتوثيق النتائج. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتعليمات العمل الآمن والإخلاء. توعية العاملين بالتعليمات والإجراءات الخاصة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. فهم عميق للقوانين واللوائح المحلية والدولية المتعلقة بالسلامة المهنية. القدرة على استخدام أجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية وتحليل البيانات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتوعية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والإدارية بدقة. مهارات تحليلية قوية للتحقيق في الحوادث وتحديد الأسباب الجذرية. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب العمل في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب المتابعة الميدانية المستمرة لضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

7c893491d6ff019f.description: About the Role Air Arabia is seeking a First Officer A320 to join their team in Dammam. This full-time position involves conducting assigned flights in accordance with the Airline Operational Manual and relevant civil aviation authority regulations. The First Officer is responsible for ensuring the ultimate safety, security, and efficiency of all operated flights, providing support and guidance to the flight and cabin crew, and effectively managing emergencies and ad-hoc scenarios. Key Responsibilities Operate assigned aircraft according to schedules and approved flight plans, prioritizing safety, efficiency, and passenger comfort. Ensure all flights adhere to the Airline’s Operations Manual and regulations, continuously implementing and monitoring procedures for safe and smooth aircraft operation. Verify timely attendance, proper grooming, fitness, and legal compliance for self and flight crew before assigned flights. Conduct pre-flight briefings and ensure ongoing briefings are performed as per adopted procedures. Coordinate with co-pilots and the Dispatch Team before each flight to ensure flight/cabin crew are prepared with necessary information, including aircraft technical status, route preferences, weather, fuel, weight, and role distribution. Ensure efficient fuel usage during flights, within the safety constraints detailed in the Airline’s Operations Manual. Oversee required safety, security, fuel, and transit checks by assigned flight/cabin crew members before, during, and after each flight. Direct crew actions in case of safety or security irregularities and escalate as needed. Collaborate with Maintenance Engineers to confirm aircraft technical status and suitability for flight. Engage MCC and MROs for concerns, identify defects, and implement immediate rectifications where applicable. Ensure all necessary documents and technical logs are accurately completed and loaded as per Airline and civil aviation authority regulations, including the technical logbook, journey book, and reports. Ensure the Airline Operations Manual is distributed, accounted for, maintained, kept up-to-date, understood, and complied with by the Flight Crew. Stay informed on legal requirements from regulatory bodies such as the civil aviation authority and Airbus Company, relevant to flights and flight crew. Undertake additional ground-based tasks, such as Safety Officer or Security Officer, as directed by the line manager and in accordance with Part A of the Airline’s Operations Manual. Required Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 4000 hours of flying experience, with a preference for Airbus 320 aircraft. Experience with a low-cost airline is highly desirable. Acceptable industry knowledge of aircraft systems and operating procedures. Demonstrated knowledge and exposure to handle delegated roles related to security or safety, as required by the Airline and civil aviation authority regulations. Exposure to QA/Safety/Security/Audit procedures and practices relevant to Flight Operations. Capability to implement policies, procedures, and manuals according to approved standards and regulations. Ability to perform effectively in a changing environment with heavy workload schedules and ad-hoc scenarios. Composed, self-confident, and focused, with the ability to handle emergencies and threats efficiently. Proven skills in data analysis, identifying pitfalls, and recommending cost-effective solutions. Cost-oriented, possessing effective problem-solving and decision-making skills. High accuracy and attention to both results and details. Ability to leverage technical expertise and interpersonal relations to support company objectives. Demonstrated ability to contribute to and successfully deliver against business strategy and set KPIs.

7c8b2bb6fcce16cf.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking an Auditor to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on ensuring financial accuracy and compliance within the hotel operations. Key Responsibilities Verify the accuracy of figures, postings, and documents. Record, store, access, and analyze computerized financial information. Monitor and ensure the security of hotel cash and cash equivalents in accordance with money handling policies and procedures. Organize, secure, and maintain all accounting books and records in compliance with document retention and confidentiality policies and procedures. Prepare, maintain, and distribute statistical, financial, accounting, audit, or payroll tables and reports. Monitor statistical, financial, accounting, audit, or payroll tables and reports. Monitor and reconcile revenue postings. Follow and enforce all company safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management; stay informed of the presence of undesirable persons on hotel premises. Adhere to all brand policies and procedures; ensure a clean and complete uniform; maintain a neat and professional appearance at all times at the workplace; respect confidentiality in the dissemination of brand and/or hotel information; protect all company assets; protect the privacy and security of guests and associates. Welcome and receive guests according to company standards, anticipate and respond to their needs, assist disabled persons, and thank guests warmly. Use clear and courteous language in all communications; accurately and completely prepare and correct written documents; answer the phone using appropriate language. Develop positive and constructive professional relationships with peers; unite and assist each other to achieve common goals; listen and respond appropriately to other employees' problems. Comply with quality requirements and standards. Independently move, lift, carry, pull, and place objects weighing up to kilograms. Perform all other tasks requested by management that are consistent with the position. Qualifications and Requirements Education: High school diploma or equivalent. Related Work Experience: No related work experience required. Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience required. Licenses or Certifications: None required. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the hospitality sector at Marriott International. The role requires adherence to established company policies and procedures, maintaining a professional demeanor, and contributing to a secure and compliant operational environment.

7c95c830c8cf7e94.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صحة المتحدة الطبية عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى توفير نقطة اتصال أولى احترافية للزوار والعملاء، وإدارة المكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم المواعيد، وضمان سير العمليات الإدارية بسلاسة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء بترحيب، وتحديد متطلباتهم، وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة لهم. إبلاغ المرجع المعني بوصول المراجعين والعملاء وتوجيههم إليه. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية، والرد على الاستفسارات، أو تحويل المكالمات إلى الأقسام المختصة. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية لجمع المعلومات المطلوبة. ترتيب وتنسيق مواعيد المقابلات بفعالية. تسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بلباقة واحترافية. مهارات اتصال ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة وقت جيدة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات المحددة. القدرة على استخدام أنظمة الاتصال والمكتب الأساسية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل منظمة في القطاع الطبي. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لشغل هذه الوظيفة.

7ca04ba2bc209eca.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking an Electrical BIM Modeler to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves developing, coordinating, and maintaining accurate 3D BIM models for electrical systems, ensuring compliance with project requirements and company standards. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Electrical BIM Modeler is responsible for producing high-quality Revit models and preparing comprehensive construction documentation. This role involves active participation in multidisciplinary coordination, supporting clash detection, and facilitating design coordination throughout the entire project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain detailed 3D electrical BIM models using Autodesk Revit. Model various electrical systems including Power Distribution, Lighting Systems, Emergency Lighting, Small Power, Fire Alarm Systems, Public Address (PA), CCTV, Access Control, Data & Communication Systems, Lightning Protection, and Earthing & Bonding Systems. Produce coordinated shop drawings, installation drawings, and construction documentation. Generate schedules, quantities, and material take-offs directly from BIM models. Coordinate with Architectural, Structural, Mechanical, Plumbing, Fire Protection, and Civil disciplines. Participate in clash detection and model coordination using Navisworks Manage. Resolve clashes and modeling issues in coordination with engineers and BIM Coordinators. Ensure all models comply with project BIM standards, LOD requirements, and BIM Execution Plans (BEP). Update BIM models based on design revisions, RFIs, and site changes. Maintain proper model organization, worksets, shared coordinates, and file management. Support the production of As-Built models upon project completion. Ensure timely delivery of BIM deliverables while maintaining high quality and accuracy. Qualifications and Requirements 3-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Good understanding of electrical systems, construction drawings, and installation practices. Familiarity with BIM standards, BIM Execution Plans (BEP), and project documentation requirements. Required Skills Strong coordination skills. Effective communication skills. Proven problem-solving abilities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

7caa9ec422de49fe.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن مهندس أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة دورة حياة الأجهزة الطبية من التركيب والتشغيل إلى الصيانة الوقائية وتشخيص الأعطال. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهندسين حديثي التخرج أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة الذين يسعون لتطوير مسيرتهم المهنية في هذا المجال الحيوي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى مهندس الأجهزة الطبية مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان الأداء الأمثل للأجهزة الطبية، وتشمل: إعداد خطط وبرامج تركيب الأجهزة الطبية، مثل أجهزة التصوير الإشعاعي والموجي وأجهزة التشخيص والمعالجة. تدريب المستخدمين على تشغيل الأجهزة الطبية بكفاءة وأمان. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة الطبية بدقة ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إجراء الفحوصات الضرورية للتأكد من دقة أداء الأجهزة بعد الصيانة أو الإصلاح. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الطبية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركة المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها بانتظام. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الأجهزة الطبية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال هندسة الأجهزة الطبية أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على إعداد خطط التركيب وبرامج التشغيل للأجهزة الطبية. مهارات قوية في تشخيص الأعطال وإجراءات الصيانة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المهندس ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تقديم أفضل الخدمات في مجال الأجهزة الطبية، مع التركيز على الجودة والدقة في الأداء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. نحن نشجع المهندسين الطموحين الذين يمتلكون الشغف بالتقنيات الطبية على التقديم لهذه الفرصة.

7cab03a9372ad895.description: About Abdul Latif Jameel Abdul Latif Jameel is a diversified business with a significant presence across the Middle East, North Africa, and Turkey (MENAT region). With a history spanning 75 years, the company has evolved from a trading business and Toyota distributorship in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, to establish an extensive operational infrastructure and the largest vehicle distribution network in Saudi Arabia. Leveraging its automotive expertise, Abdul Latif Jameel has diversified into new sectors that contribute to the 'infrastructure of life' in the MENAT region. Role Overview Abdul Latif Jameel is seeking a Technical Service Operations GM to join its team in Makkah, with operations covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is central to ensuring the proper implementation of Early Detection & Early Resolution (EDER) activities. The General Manager will be responsible for reflecting field concerns to manufacturers and contributing to overall customer satisfaction by providing timely and accurate technical assistance to service outlets. Key Responsibilities Improve and maintain systems for gathering technical data from the field. Supervise Product Managers in investigating high-occurrence technical problems. Communicate and follow up on top technical problems with manufacturers (TMC). Ensure the proper implementation of service and recall campaigns. Handle serious customer technical complaints related to products. Analyze Field Technical Report (FTR) data and review unusual patterns of warranty claims. Analyze parts demand data for recall campaigns. Participate in Conformity/Suitability tests, POD, POE, and other product quality activities. Impact and Strategic Focus This role directly impacts the proper implementation of Early Detection & Early Resolution activities and the issuance of high-quality Market Product Reports. It also indirectly contributes to customer satisfaction. The General Manager holds a crucial strategic role in achieving targets for FTR quality, quantity, and speed, and is responsible for organizing quality services with manufacturers and ensuring the proper implementation of service and recall campaigns. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to communicate new technical problems to manufacturers and ensure permanent solutions. Proven track record in providing high-quality technical support to service centers. Experience in launching service and recall campaigns efficiently and effectively. Working at Abdul Latif Jameel Abdul Latif Jameel offers opportunities across its international footprint, guided by values of Respect, Innovation, a Pioneering Spirit, and Empowerment. The company fosters a culture where ideas and people can thrive.

7cb9ead6dd2ed345.description: About the Role Tuwaiq Casting & Forging Company is seeking a Utility Operator to join the Maintenance Department within the Operations Division. This full-time position is based in Ras Tannurah, Eastern Region, and involves operating essential utility services for the plant. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Context and Purpose The Utility Operator reports to the Utilities Specialist and works as part of the Utilities shift team. This role is responsible for the safe, environmentally responsible, and efficient operation of utility services, including air, water, electricity, and wastewater treatment. The operator ensures these services comply with standard operating procedures and process control parameters, supporting the operational targets of various utility consumers across melting, casting, forging, heat treatment, and machining operations. Key Responsibilities Adhere to EHS regulations and guidelines, maintaining a safe working environment. Contribute to reporting and resolving near misses and incidents, and conduct site inspections. Maintain high standards of quality for supplied utilities in accordance with work instructions and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Coordinate utility sample collection as required. Complete and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly utility production and operation reports accurately. Monitor utility raw materials, consumable materials, and outsourced services to ensure smooth utility operations. Support maintenance activities, including taking equipment offline, isolating, tagging, and bringing utility equipment or systems back online after repairs. Assist with on-site and off-site hands-on training and coaching of new or existing utility operators. Conduct plant patrolling tours and complete shift inspection records. Report EHSS incidents and accidents promptly. Submit utility shift reports as required. Initiate ordering of required raw materials and chemical consumables. Raise maintenance requests to address equipment issues. Escalate serious utility operation and maintenance risks to the Utilities Specialist. Suggest operational, equipment, or process improvements. Qualifications and Experience Education: Technical Certificate or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Utilities, Industrial Maintenance, or an equivalent field. Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in utilities operation or maintenance in an industrial, manufacturing, foundry, forging, or heavy manufacturing environment (for Diploma or Technical Certificate holders). Minimum 6 years of relevant utilities operation experience (for High School certificate holders). Experience in the operation and maintenance of utility systems such as compressed air, water systems, electrical distribution, wastewater treatment, LPG, technical gases, pumps, compressors, chillers, or cooling systems is preferred. Work Environment This role is a full-time position within the Maintenance Department of the Operations Division, working as part of a shift team to ensure continuous utility service delivery. Application Information Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

7ccbccdb3c8da7f4.description: About the Role Hilton International is seeking an Assistant Director of Sales to join its team in Dammam, Eastern Province. This full-time role involves supporting the hotel's sales strategy and contributing to the delivery of guest experiences. Key Responsibilities Drive sales within a key market segment by managing a designated vertical market, qualifying leads, conducting outreach, delivering proposals, and closing business to meet revenue goals. Support strategic sales planning by contributing to the hotel’s annual commercial strategy, aligning sales activities with business objectives, and collaborating with the broader commercial team. Execute targeted sales initiatives, representing the hotel at tradeshows, client events, and sales calls, maintaining a robust pipeline, and developing plans for short- and long-term business. Enhance customer engagement by building relationships with clients, Hilton Worldwide Sales, Convention and Visitors Bureaus, and intermediaries, leading site inspections, and ensuring client experiences. Support sales performance and processes by aligning day-to-day team activities with strategic goals and reinforcing business processes that drive revenue across Rooms, Catering, and Events. Track performance and market trends, monitoring business metrics, analyzing the competitive landscape, and adjusting tactics to meet evolving customer needs and market dynamics. Inspire and develop the team through recruitment, training, supervision, and mentorship, conducting performance evaluations, providing professional development opportunities, and recognizing achievements. Core Values and Qualities Candidates for this role should align with Hilton's core values, which include: A passion for hospitality. Acting with integrity and doing what is right. Inspiring others through leadership. A belief that teamwork drives optimal outcomes. A sense of ownership and accountability. A focus on the present, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment. Work Environment Hilton is recognized for its workplace culture, having received recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. The company is committed to providing a supportive environment for its team members.

7cd1f281bf1e6385.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث ورشة الترتيب العالي لصيانة السيارات عن كاتب علاقات حكومية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تسهيل وتخليص المعاملات الحكومية ومتابعة شؤون الموظفين بكفاءة وفعالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمعلومات اللازمة حول الوثائق والمستندات والشروط المطلوبة لتخليص المعاملات الحكومية. تأمين وتوفير المستندات المطلوبة وتخليص المعاملات بسرعة وفعالية وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. تحديث واستكمال جميع متطلبات النماذج والمستندات والإجراءات الحكومية بما يتوافق مع القوانين واللوائح المنظمة للعمل. تنفيذ التعليمات المتعلقة بسرية التعاملات والسجلات والتعامل معها بمهنية عالية. حفظ الوثائق وتبويبها وترتيبها بالاستناد إلى الممارسات المتبعة في الشركة. استقبال استفسارات الموظفين والإجابة عنها، ومتابعة معاملاتهم بالتنسيق مع الوحدات الخارجية المعنية، وإحاطتهم بكافة المستجدات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الإجراءات الحكومية والمتطلبات القانونية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية ممتازة. القدرة على التواصل الفعال مع الجهات الداخلية والخارجية. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إنجاز المهام. الالتزام بالسرية والمهنية في التعامل مع المعلومات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق ورشة الترتيب العالي لصيانة السيارات في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة التفاصيل.

7c230b3cbd3bdc8b.description: We are looking for a motivated fresh graduate in Architecture and Urban Planning to join our client's team. The ideal candidate should have a relevant bachelor's degree and basic knowledge of architectural design and urban planning. Key Responsibilities Assist in preparing architectural drawings, layouts, and design plans. Support urban planning and development projects. Prepare technical reports and project documentation. Assist in reviewing drawings and design specifications. Coordinate with engineering and project teams. Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Urban Planning, or a related field. 7c47053d653da664.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مدارات الوسط للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى المهندس المدني في هذا الدور مسؤولية دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسبة تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. فهم عميق لدراسة المواقع الإنشائية وتحليل التربة. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية وتدقيق المخططات. مهارات ممتازة في الإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع. نوع العمل والموقع هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور ضمن فريق شركة مدارات الوسط للمقاولات.

7ce7004efa13a8c3.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Project Engineer Electrical (Substation) to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves the execution and supervision of 380kV substation projects, ensuring adherence to project specifications, SEC standards, and safety and quality requirements. Role Overview The Project Engineer will be responsible for overseeing the electrical and civil works associated with 380kV substations. This includes managing day-to-day site operations, coordinating with various stakeholders, and ensuring all activities align with approved designs and schedules. The role requires a strong focus on compliance with industry and client standards. Key Responsibilities Manage the daily site execution of 380kV BSP/substation projects. Coordinate effectively with engineering teams, construction personnel, subcontractors, and SEC representatives. Ensure all work is executed strictly according to approved drawings, method statements, and project specifications. Monitor project progress, resource allocation including manpower and materials, and overall site resources. Facilitate timely inspections, testing, documentation, and closure of all site activities. Identify and resolve technical and construction-related issues promptly. Maintain continuous compliance with Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE), Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC), and Saudi Electricity Company (SEC) requirements. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor of Technology (** or Bachelor of Engineering ( in Electrical Engineering. 10-15 years of relevant experience in project execution. Demonstrated experience specifically in 380kV BSP/substation projects. Mandatory SEC approval. Strong knowledge of SEC standards, project execution methodologies, site coordination, and subcontractor management. Experience with High Voltage (HV) Substations. Key Competencies Proficiency in substation construction practices. Strong understanding of quality and safety management principles. Effective stakeholder management, including interaction with SEC, consultants, and contractors. Developed planning, scheduling, and execution skills. Ability to perform effectively in a multicultural and demanding work environment. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is a full-time position. The successful candidate will operate within a dynamic project environment, collaborating with diverse teams and external entities to deliver critical infrastructure projects.

7c0b59a4aceee428.description: About the Role Catrion Group is seeking a Specialist, QHSE for a permanent position in Turaif and Dammam. This role is responsible for monitoring and maintaining food safety, quality assurance, and safety activities within the department and unit. The Specialist will coordinate with various stakeholders, provide training, and ensure compliance with established standards. Key Responsibilities Monitor and maintain food Safety & Quality Assurance activities in the department. Meticulously maintain all food Safety & Quality Assurance records. Coordinate with the Site Manager to resolve issues related to food Safety & Quality Assurance. Train and evaluate new Quality Control staff and submit necessary reports to the Site Manager. Coordinate with different sections of the unit to resolve food Safety & Quality Assurance issues based on Daily Hygiene Reports. Monitor and maintain pest control activities undertaken by the pest control contractor. Ensure that laboratory-related activities, such as drawing of samples (food, water, handprints, cleaning control), are regularly conducted by Quality Controllers on-duty. Investigate customer complaints with respective departments and provide comprehensive and logical feedback along with corrective action taken to the Section Head. Provide new hire training, refresher training, and on-job-training for all food handlers as per the training schedule. Liaise with the medical department for food handler’s certificates, staff post-vacation clearance, and staff infection control. Carry out follow-up hygiene inspection of supplier’s premises and outlets as assigned. Prepare the roster to monitor and maintain 24-hour coverage of food Safety & Quality Assurance activities. Coordinate with the Site Manager regarding the yearly department budget. Ensure optimum use of stationary, printing, office supplies, and lab chemicals. Complete any other related tasks assigned by the Site Manager. Act as Site Manager during their absence (during delegation period). Conduct safety inspections and prepare reports. Conduct safety-related training needs assessments in the workplace. Maintain awareness of active and developing safety situations. Assist the accident investigation team for investigations. Conduct on-job training, Tool Box Talks (TBT), and safety brief awareness sessions. Inspect the site to ensure a hazard-free environment. Verify that all tools and equipment are adequate and safe for use. Promote safe practices at the job site. Enforce safety guidelines. Respond to employee’s safety concerns. Cover different remote locations as per work needs. Work Conditions The role accommodates special provisions for people with disabilities, including flexible working hours and necessary accessibility needs such as facility access and technology.

7c8bcdc21594b018.description: About the Role NCR Atleos is seeking an experienced PS Senior Project Manager to support the delivery of strategic enterprise initiatives within the Capital portfolio for a major financial institution in KSA. This full-time role is based in Makkah, specifically covering Jeddah and Makkah, and is critical for driving high-impact projects and ensuring successful delivery within a complex financial services environment. Role Overview The Senior Project Manager will lead the planning, execution, and delivery of enterprise-wide projects through an outsourcing engagement. This position requires strong project leadership and stakeholder management, with the ability to coordinate effectively across business, technology, and vendor teams. The role involves managing project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, and governance requirements, ensuring alignment with business objectives and delivery standards. Key Responsibilities Leading the planning, execution, and successful delivery of enterprise-wide projects. Ensuring project alignment with business objectives, timelines, budgets, and quality standards. Coordinating project activities across business, technology, and vendor teams. Driving stakeholder engagement and maintaining effective communication across project participants. Monitoring project risks, issues, and dependencies, and implementing mitigation plans as needed. Tracking project progress and providing regular status updates to senior management. Ensuring adherence to project governance, delivery methodologies, and quality standards. Proven experience in delivering strategic enterprise initiatives, preferably within the financial services sector. Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects involving multiple stakeholders and vendor teams. 7c38cb37d9963b6a.description: About the Role Impetus Executive is seeking an Enterprise Sales Manager for a full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role is with a fast-growing global financial technology company specializing in digital payments and payment infrastructure. The company supports enterprise businesses in managing, optimizing, and scaling their online payment operations by providing technology-driven payment solutions. Role Overview The Enterprise Sales Manager will be responsible for identifying, developing, and closing high-value opportunities across Saudi Arabia. The focus will be on banks, financial institutions, large e-commerce businesses, marketplaces, digital platforms, and other high-volume enterprise merchants. This is a full-cycle enterprise sales role, requiring ownership from prospecting and account development through discovery, solution positioning, commercial negotiations, contract closure, and handover to implementation/account management teams. Key Responsibilities Own the full enterprise sales cycle across the Saudi Arabian market, from prospecting to contract closure. Develop and execute a strategic sales plan focused on large enterprise accounts. Identify and build relationships with senior decision-makers across banks, financial institutions, e-commerce companies, marketplaces, and digital businesses. Generate new business through strategic account planning, outbound prospecting, networking, partnerships, and industry relationships. Build and maintain a strong enterprise pipeline and consistently achieve or exceed revenue targets. Conduct consultative discovery with C-level and senior stakeholders to understand business, commercial, and payment challenges. Position complex payment, acquiring, payment gateway, fraud, risk, authentication, and payment optimization solutions according to customer needs. Lead complex enterprise sales processes involving multiple stakeholders across commercial, technical, product, finance, risk, and procurement teams. Develop business cases and value propositions demonstrating measurable commercial impact, such as improved payment acceptance, conversion, customer experience, and payment performance. Manage commercial negotiations and navigate long enterprise procurement cycles. Work closely with Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal, Risk, Compliance, and Customer Success teams to deliver a seamless sales process. Build long-term relationships with strategic accounts and identify opportunities for expansion, upselling, and cross-selling. Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasting, and CRM activity. Represent the company at relevant events. Candidate Profile and Experience The ideal candidate will have a strong background in FinTech, payments, and B2B SaaS, with a proven track record of selling complex technology solutions to large enterprise organizations. Experience selling into Saudi Arabia and established relationships with enterprise decision-makers are highly valued. Previous experience selling technology or payment solutions to banks, financial institutions, payment service providers, large e-commerce companies, marketplaces, digital platforms, retail and consumer technology companies, large enterprise merchants, FinTech companies, or SaaS and technology businesses is preferred. Qualifications and Requirements 8+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience, ideally within FinTech, payments, SaaS, or financial technology. Proven track record of selling complex technology solutions to enterprise clients. Strong experience managing the full sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, solution selling, negotiation, and closing. Demonstrated experience selling to banks, financial institutions, e-commerce businesses, or large enterprise merchants. Strong understanding of the digital payments ecosystem and payment technologies. Experience selling SaaS/technology solutions is required. Strong understanding of payment concepts such as payment gateways, acquiring, payment processing, payment methods, authorization/acceptance, fraud, and risk management. Experience managing long, complex enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders. Strong commercial and consultative selling skills. Proven ability to engage with C-level and senior executives. Excellent negotiation, presentation, and relationship-management skills. Strong understanding of the Saudi business environment and enterprise buying processes. Willingness to travel within Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC when required. Application Process Candidates meeting the above qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary for this position will not be disclosed.

7c93f44bcc8455ed.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اغادير نجد للمقاولات عن مدير أشغال ومرافق عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في وادي الدواسر. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق في المنشأة، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية الحالية والمستقبلية، التصاميم، والأثاث، بالإضافة إلى تخطيط جداول الصيانة والتنظيف. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الخطط والسياسات والاستراتيجيات الإدارية العامة لمرافق الشركة، والإشراف على تنفيذها. ضمان الالتزام بقواعد ولوائح الصحة والسلامة والبيئة ومباشرة تنفيذها. مباشرة الأنشطة اليومية للمرافق في المنشأة، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية، التصاميم، والأثاث. تخطيط الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمرافق. مباشرة أنشطة الصيانة وتنسيق عمليات التصليح مع تقليل مدة التوقف عن العمل. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة أدائهم وسلوكهم مقارنةً بالأهداف المحددة. تخطيط أعمال الإنشاء والملحقات الجديدة، وإعداد العقود المتعلقة بالبناء ومراجعتها والموافقة عليها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المرافق أو الأشغال العامة. فهم قوي لمبادئ تخطيط المرافق والصيانة. القدرة على إدارة المشاريع وتنسيق الفرق. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية ممتازة. القدرة على التخطيط الاستراتيجي والتنفيذ الفعال. مهارات تواصل قوية وفعالة. القدرة على اتخاذ القرارات وحل المشكلات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في وادي الدواسر، الرياض. سيعمل مدير الأشغال والمرافق العامة ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة اغادير نجد للمقاولات، ويكون مسؤولاً عن الإشراف على جميع جوانب إدارة المرافق لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

7c9650ed43b72fbd.description: About PepsiCo PepsiCo products are consumed over a billion times daily across more than 200 countries and territories. In 2021, PepsiCo generated over $79 billion in net revenue through its diverse portfolio of beverages and convenient foods, including brands such as LAY’S ®️, DORITOS ®️, CHEETOS ®️, GATORADE ®️, PEPSI ®️, and QUAKER ®️. The company's vision is to be a global leader in beverages and convenient foods, guided by PepsiCo Positive (pep+), a strategic transformation focused on sustainability and human capital. Role Overview PepsiCo is seeking a Sr. Route Salesman to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is integral to the sales team, focusing on maximizing sales volume, minimizing product waste, achieving distribution targets, and ensuring high levels of customer service. The role requires adherence to operating procedures to maintain consistent standards across KSA and involves providing market information to supervisors for sales opportunity development. Key Responsibilities Sell the full range of products to an agreed list of customers, aiming to meet or exceed sales targets and keep product stales below the specified target. Provide customer service as approved by the supervisor, maintaining call frequency and adhering to the daily route plan to ensure customer satisfaction. Conduct daily and weekly vehicle checks as per operating procedures, ensuring the sales vehicle is clean and roadworthy, and reporting any defects or damage promptly. Agree on order requirements for the next selling period daily. Maintain individual customer stock levels to agreed requirements to minimize out-of-stock situations. Implement agreed in-store merchandising standards communicated by the supervisor, coordinating with company merchandisers where applicable. Advise the supervisor of any relevant competitor activity within the assigned area during daily debriefing sessions. Perform daily reconciliation of all cheques, cash, and credit sales, ensuring zero stock and cash shortages. Maintain a neat and presentable appearance at all times. Adhere to high driving standards and obey all driving regulations. Performance Indicators Daily/weekly sales performance against planned sales. Daily positive calls versus plan. Daily call sequence adherence versus plan. Product stales versus target. Absence of cash and stock shortages. Professional Development The Sr. Route Salesman will participate in training courses designed to enhance professionalism and customer service skills. Daily debriefing sessions with the supervisor are also a mandatory part of the role to review performance and market insights. 7cbe3b0e1461f321.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ثرى الرياض للتجارة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع، بالإضافة إلى متابعة التحصيلات. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات التي تقدمها الشركة. بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمحتملين، مع توثيق بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء أو زيارتهم لتقديم عروض البيع وترويج المنتجات، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء، تسجيلها، توثيقها، وتوريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تساهم في تحقيق الأهداف المهنية والشخصية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

7cdc81f1e6305204.description: About the Role Emdad By Elm is seeking an Automation & Maintenance Engineer to ensure the reliable operation and maintenance of automated packaging systems for cards and vehicle license plates. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves machine setup, daily operation, troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and continuous improvement to meet production targets, maintain packaging quality, and ensure accurate matching of items with recipient information. Key Responsibilities Operate, configure, and monitor automated packaging machines, including feeding, identification, envelope insertion, adhesive sealing, label printing and application, and sorting. Perform machine setup and changeovers for various card and vehicle plate sizes, packaging materials, and order types. Diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and control system faults to minimize downtime. Inspect, adjust, and maintain sensors, motors, servo drives, conveyors, feeders, rollers, pneumatic components, and adhesive application systems. Troubleshoot PLC-controlled equipment and HMI alarms using electrical diagrams, machine manuals, and diagnostic tools. Maintain barcode readers, vision systems, thermal printers, and labeling equipment. Maintain, calibrate, and troubleshoot OCR, barcode readers, cameras, lighting, triggers, and related identification components for item recognition and verification. Verify accurate matching between cards or plates, recipient data, shipping labels, and assigned sorting outlets. Monitor rejected, unreadable, mismatched, and process-failed items, ensuring proper reconciliation between input records, processed items, successfully packaged items, rejected items, and final sorting outputs. Monitor and troubleshoot sorting logic, conveyor routing, diverters, sensors, and output lanes to ensure items are directed to the correct destination. Coordinate with IT teams and equipment manufacturers to resolve machine communication, data exchange, and software interface issues. Control approved machine recipes, parameters, configurations, and software settings, ensuring changes are authorized and documented, and maintaining approved backups in coordination with IT and equipment manufacturers. Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules according to manufacturer recommendations. Record breakdowns, maintenance activities, spare parts usage, and corrective actions; conduct root cause analysis for recurring failures. Identify critical spare parts and consumables and coordinate minimum stock requirements to reduce maintenance-related downtime. Monitor production throughput, downtime, packaging defects, and rejection rates, and implement improvements. Monitor machine availability and identification accuracy against approved operational and acceptance targets, in addition to throughput, downtime, defects, and rejection performance. Support installation, commissioning, factory and site acceptance testing, and production readiness activities. Participate in performance and stress testing, verify reject handling and functional requirements, and support punch-list closure and final production readiness. Train operators on machine operation, changeovers, routine checks, and basic troubleshooting. Follow machine safety, energy isolation, information security, and item traceability procedures. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of direct experience with automated industrial equipment. Experience with office printers, photocopiers, or general IT support alone does not meet the requirements for this role. Required Competencies Hands-on troubleshooting skills. Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude. Attention to detail. Safety awareness. Ownership of equipment reliability. Effective coordination with operations, IT, and suppliers. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.
